copy.tagline: 为 /config 功能添加测试并保持 UI 一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在实现或扩展应用的 /config 功能
copy.tagline_en: Add tests and maintain UI parity for /config features
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are implementing or extending /config functionality

howto.what: 装了这个技能，当你要求Claude修改或扩展/config里的配置项（比如存储、提示注入、请求参数、UI开关）时，它会按照规范更新相关文档和代码，并运行测试确保正确。
howto.when: 当你让Claude实现或扩展/config功能，例如添加新设置、修改持久化方式或更新UI配置时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加一个名为'autoSave'的配置项到/config。
say.note: Claude会按工作流添加并确保测试通过。

say.text: 修改/config中的outputStyle选项，支持更多样式。
在/config中增加一个UI开关，控制是否显示思考过程。
say.note: Claude会分类为UI-only并避免影响模型上下文。

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you ask Claude to modify or extend /config settings (storage, prompt injection, request params, UI toggles), it follows a strict workflow: updates docs, changes code, and runs tests to ensure correctness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to implement or extend /config features, such as adding a new setting, changing persistence, or updating UI configuration.

say_en.text: Add a new config setting called 'autoSave' to /config.
say_en.note: Claude follows the workflow and ensures tests pass.

say_en.text: Modify the outputStyle option in /config to support more styles.
say_en.note: Claude updates schema and persistence logic.

say_en.text: Add a UI-only toggle to /config for controlling thinking block visibility.
say_en.note: Claude classifies it as UI-only and avoids affecting model context.
